$comment: Single checkable record of the fixed verification baseline: harness revision anchor, run/acceptance artifact, and dependency lockfiles. Checked by tests/harness-dock/baseline.test.ts. Support status and the verification policy stay in framework/docs/harness-support.md; this file records only the correspondence between the anchor, the artifact actually run, and the lockfiles.

revisionAnchor.role: source of truth for the supported behavior; never imported by this repository's code or tests

acceptanceArtifact.installCommand: bun install in the prefix directory with an exact dependency entry
acceptanceArtifact.role: the only harness that acceptance/verification runs execute; the local checkout cannot run a full session because its native addon is not built

byteIdentity.source: reused conclusion of decision 03 (.scratch/codebase-tools-omp-v1/decision/03-extension-path-probes.md, probe assets under assets/03): the isolated 18.5.0 install is byte-identical to the checkout for the files that carry the extension, session, model and auth contracts

conditions: Accepted runs execute the isolated exact install under a temporary agent state and isolated capture directories; the default global install, formal configuration and any running agent are never touched.
No native addon build is part of acceptance: the isolated install ships prebuilt win32-x64 natives.
The local checkout is a source/revision anchor only; it is not used to run full sessions because packages/natives ships no built addon.
